_comment: Static Agent Profile file for deployments without PCS.
Mount it read-only and set PROFILES_FILE=/opt/platform/agent-profiles.json on builders.
The model credential comes from the container environment (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY /
ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, passed through PLATFORM_AGENT_PASS_ENV and cli-agent --pass-env),
so no api_profiles entry or secret_ref is needed here.
With PCS in the deployment, leave PROFILES_FILE unset: PCS exports the runtime view instead.
